info.name: Get the SLI for an SLX

params.name: detail
params.description: Accepted for Django parity; ignored (always returns full detail)

items.docs:
Get the SLI for an SLX.

SLX and SLI have a 1:1 relationship. This endpoint returns the single
SLI associated with the specified SLX, or 404 if no SLI exists.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name.
    slx_short_name: The SLX short name.
    _detail: Django parity query param (ignored).
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    The SLI details.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if workspace, SLX, or SLI not found.

info.name: Push alert rules for all SLIs with alertConfig

items.docs:
Push Prometheus alert rules to the metric store for every SLI in the workspace that has an alertConfig.

Bypasses the SHA-based sync deduplication — safe to call even when workspace YAML has not changed.
Useful for bootstrapping alert rules after a new cluster is stood up or after
METRIC_STORE_RULER_URL is first configured.

Returns a summary with counts and any per-SLX errors.

Get runners and health status for an SLI.

Health is derived from the freshness of the runner's ``last_heartbeat`` column,
which is updated on every ``POST /runners/status`` from the runner agent. A
runner is considered Healthy if its heartbeat is within
``settings.runner_heartbeat_staleness_seconds`` (default 90s).

Note: the legacy Django implementation (``HasCodeRunLocationsMixin.list_locations``)
derived health from ``status.runnerLocations[*].status.code`` on the SLI CRD —
a string set by t
